27 August 2002

## Circular to SFC's Registered Intermediaries Notification of in-house training sessions by corporate licensees

Corporate licensees are currently required to notify the Commission of their internal training sessions and submit the relevant training materials at least 5 working days in advance.  To alleviate  the  administrative  burden  of  the  industry,  with  immediate  effect,  the  Commission considered that such notification and submission would no longer be required.

Nevertheless,  corporate  licensees  should  continue  to  keep  proper  training  and  attendance records  for  each  training  session,  and  report  status  of  Continuous  Professional  Training ('CPT') compliance in their Annual Returns.  The Commission may also request for training information in its annual Business  Activities Survey, or at  any  other  time  deemed appropriate.

If  you  have  any  enquiries  regarding  the  above,  please  refer  to  the  'Frequently  Asked Questions  on  CPT'  posted  on  the  Commission's  website  at  www.hksfc.org.hk  or  contact your responsible Intermediaries Relationship Manager of the Licensing Department.
